title: update translation credits
symptom: The credits.xml file, which lists translators, has not been updated since January 2018, while many people have recently contributed to translations. The EULA screen in Settings shows an outdated list of translators.
cause: The credits.xml file was created by jamorham to give credit to translators from a previous system before Crowdin was used. Translators on Crowdin are not visible to GitHub, so the file has not been updated.
fix: jamorham suggested keeping the credits.xml file in the source tree for historical record and recognition, but removing its visibility from the EULA screen because it does not reflect the current state of translator contributions.
evidence_quote: I'd consider keeping this file in the source tree for historical record and recognition but removing its visibility from the EULA screen as it doesn't reflect the current state of translator contributions.
